title: The Evening Brief: Saturday quiet; whale flows shift direction as leverage cools
dek: No news drove Saturday's session. The desk's boards show bitcoin and ether edged lower on light flows, while whale accumulation reversed sharply this week: after three weeks of consistent buying pressure onto exchanges, the week ending October 17 flipped to $67 million moving off exchanges.
author: GoCheckMyCrypto
key_fact: Weekly whale flows reversed direction this week, $67 million of bitcoin moved off exchanges in the week ending October 17, breaking a three-week streak of accumulation onto trading venues, while spot ETF outflows persisted and leverage funding remained calm.
bottom_line: Saturday brought no news, and the market drifted lower on thin flows. Spot ETF outflows persisted, with $82.4 million out on October 16 and $228.4 million out over the week, while leverage funding remained subdued and long-heavy across Bitcoin and Ether. The coming week will test whether whale de-risking accelerates or stabilizes.
body: Saturday saw no news move the market. Per the desk's boards, Bitcoin down 0.47% over 24 hours, Ether down 1.20% over 24 hours, and Solana down 1.16% over 24 hours. Across the week, Bitcoin down 1.26% over seven days, Ether down 2.62% over seven days, and Solana down 4.36% over seven days. Over the month, Bitcoin up 7.06% over thirty days, while Ether up 0.19% over thirty days and Solana up 5.86% over thirty days. Among movers, XMR up 1.47% over 24 hours and HBAR up 1.20% over 24 hours led gainers; ZRO down 9.51% over 24 hours, FIL down 6.70% over 24 hours, and STX down 6.09% over 24 hours topped losers.

The desk's spot ETF data showed spot Bitcoin ETFs saw net outflows of $82.4M on the day, October 16, and spot Bitcoin ETFs saw net outflows of $228.4M over the week through October 16. Ethereum spot ETFs have posted three consecutive days of outflows, with last five sessions net of $320.1 million out.

Whale activity on the desk's Whale Watch board painted a striking reversal. However, the weekly lens tells a different story: in the week ending October 17, $67 million moved off exchanges, a pivot after three consecutive weeks of accumulation onto trading venues. The week ending October 10 saw $1,503 million move onto exchanges; the week ending October 3 saw $804 million onto exchanges; the week ending September 26 saw $428 million onto exchanges. This week's shift, per the board, reversed that direction.

On leverage, the desk's boards show funding remained calm. Bitcoin funding stood at 0.0053% over 8 hours at OKX, or 5.8% annualized. Ether funding was 0.0028% over 8 hours, or 3.1% annualized. Both assets held long-skewed positioning: Bitcoin's long-to-short ratio at OKX sat at 1.81, and Ether's at 2.42. Liquidations over the past 2 hours on OKX totaled 100 events across BTC, with $1,413,504 in long liquidations and $45,978 in short liquidations; for ETH, 100 events posted $1,047,794 in long liquidations and $148,428 in short liquidations. Fear and Greed per the desk's index was 55, labeled Greed, within a 30-day range of 53 to 78.
